items.headline: No. 21 UCLA downs turnover-plagued No. 13 Oregon 17-15 to remain undefeated
items.description: — Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another score, and No. 21 UCLA overcame an injury to starting quarterback Nico Iamaleava to remain undefeated with a 17-15 victory over No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.

items.headline: UCLA Bruins vs. Oregon Ducks: Game Highlights
items.description: UCLA Bruins vs. Oregon Ducks: Game Highlights

items.headline: With injured Nico Iamaleava on sideline, UCLA stuns Oregon
items.description: An injured Nico Iamaleava did not start the second half on Saturday for UCLA against Oregon, and he watched from the sideline as backup quarterback Ty Dieffenbach helped to orchestrate the No. 21 Bruins' 17-15 upset of the No. 13 Ducks at Autzen Stadium.
